title: Invoice status with a data migration
prompt: Invoices need a lifecycle: add a `status` field with the values `draft`, `issued`, `paid`. New invoices are created as `draft`. Add POST /invoices/:id/issue and POST /invoices/:id/pay that move draft to issued and issued to paid, answering 409 on any other transition. Existing records in data/invoices.json have no status and must be treated as `issued`: write a migration script under scripts/ that rewrites the file once (idempotent), run it against data/invoices.json, and make the repository tolerate unmigrated records by defaulting them to `issued` when reading. Tests for the transitions, the read default and the migration.
